classes.label: 0-back
classes.description: Tarea fácil: basta con reconocer cada dígito, sin recordar los anteriores.
classes.description_en: Easy task: each digit only has to be recognised, with no earlier digits to remember.

classes.label: 2/3-back
classes.description: Tarea difícil: decir si cada dígito es igual al de 2 o 3 posiciones antes, así que hay que recordar los últimos dígitos.
classes.description_en: Hard task: say whether each digit equals the one 2 or 3 positions back, so the last digits have to be held in memory.

variables.label: HbO en AF7
variables.description: Cambio medio de HbO (oxihemoglobina) en el canal AF7 entre 10 y 40 s del bloque, respecto a la media de −5 a −2 s (mmol/L, región aproximada: corteza prefrontal izquierda).
variables.description_en: Mean change of HbO (oxyhaemoglobin) at channel AF7 10 to 40 s into the block, relative to the mean from −5 to −2 s (mmol/L, approximate region: left prefrontal cortex).

rules.text: IF tmb_s1_chAF7 IS Low AND tmb_s2_chFCC4 IS at least Medium: carga de memoria centred weights (+ supports, - suppresses) 0-back +0.98 | 2/3-back -0.98
IF tmb_s1_chAFpz IS at most Medium AND tmb_s2_chPO2 IS High: carga de memoria centred weights (+ supports, - suppresses) 0-back +0.54 | 2/3-back -0.54
IF tmb_s1_chAF8 IS at most Medium: carga de memoria centred weights (+ supports, - suppresses) 0-back +0.13 | 2/3-back -0.13
IF tmb_s1_chPO1 IS at least Medium AND tmb_s1_chPO2 IS Medium: carga de memoria centred weights (+ supports, - suppresses) 0-back +0.02 | 2/3-back -0.02

montage.frame: unit sphere; x towards the right ear, y towards the nose, z towards the vertex
montage.source: Shin et al. (2018), Dataset description_MATLAB.pdf, table 'Locations of NIRS channels in Cartesian coordinate system'
montage.region_source: ex-Fuzzy fNIRS demo (Caterson et al.), notebook 005_Visualisation_Demo_with_PyCirclize.ipynb, commit 244d8a0: approximate Brodmann area and brain region per channel
